034/**
035 * The server half of the console message bus: a retained-value store plus the sessions that bridge it to pages.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * Publish from anywhere in the application; every connected page whose bridge was granted the topic receives it
039 * (and every page that connects later receives the retained value).  Topics not allowed by the {@link BusPolicy}
040 * are refused loudly (E-56).
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * The methods under "transport SPI" are public for {@link BusEventsMixin} and {@code BusWebSockets}; application code
044 * does not call them.
045 *
046 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
047 * <p class='bjava'>
048 *   <jc>// One per application (or per resource), shared by the REST resource and any background work.</jc>
049 *   ServerBus <jv>bus</jv> = ServerBus.<jsm>create</jsm>(BusPolicy.<jsm>create</jsm>()
050 *     .downstream(<js>"ops.jobs"</js>, <jk>true</jk>)
051 *     .downstream(<js>"cmd:jobs"</js>, <jk>false</jk>)
052 *     .build());
053 *
054 *   <jv>bus</jv>.publish(<js>"ops.jobs"</js>, JsonMap.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"schemaVersion"</js>, 1, <js>"running"</js>, <jv>running</jv>));
055 *   <jv>bus</jv>.publish(<js>"cmd:jobs"</js>, JsonMap.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"schemaVersion"</js>, 1, <js>"op"</js>, <js>"reload"</js>));
056 *
057 *   <jc>// Only to one user's pages (never retained):</jc>
058 *   <jv>bus</jv>.publishTo(<jv>s</jv> -&gt; <js>"jb"</js>.equals(<jv>s</jv>.principalName()), <js>"ops.jobs"</js>, <jv>mine</jv>);
059 * </p>
060 *
061 * @since 10.0.0
062 */
063@SuppressWarnings({
064   "java:S1192", // Transport names and refusal reasons are protocol literals; named constants would not clarify them.
065   "java:S3776" // Branching is inherent to openSession() and receive().
066})
067public final class ServerBus implements AutoCloseable {
068
069   private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(ServerBus.class.getName());
070   private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();
071   private static final AtomicLong STREAM_KEYS = new AtomicLong();
072
073   /** Session id strength: 256 bits, written as 64 hex characters. */
074   static final int ID_BYTES = 32;
075
076   /** The transports a session POST may request. */
077   static final Set<String> TRANSPORTS = Set.of("sse", "websocket");
078
079   /** The longest denied topic a 403 body echoes back. */
080   static final int MAX_ECHO_LENGTH = 128;
081
082   /** The most topics one session POST may request in each direction. */
083   static final int MAX_TOPICS = 256;
084
085   private final BusPolicy policy;
086   private final Clock clock;
087   private final ScheduledExecutorService timer;
088   private final SseBroadcaster sseStreams;
089   private final Object lock = new Object();
090
091   // Guarded by lock.
092   private final SortedMap<String,String> retained = new TreeMap<>();
093   private final Map<String,SessionImpl> sessions = new LinkedHashMap<>();
094   private boolean closed;
095
096   private volatile String webSocketPrefix;
097
098   ServerBus(BusPolicy policy, Clock clock, ScheduledExecutorService timer) {
099      this.policy = Objects.requireNonNull(policy, "policy");
100      this.clock = Objects.requireNonNull(clock, "clock");
101      this.timer = timer;
102      // One spare slot per queue: SseFrameSink bounds itself at maxQueuedFrames, so drop-oldest never runs.
103      this.sseStreams = new SseBroadcaster(policy.maxQueuedFrames() + 1);
104   }
105
106   /**
107    * Creates a bus and starts its timer (one daemon thread: heartbeat pings and session expiry).
108    *
109    * @param policy The policy.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
110    * @return A new bus.  {@link #close()} it when the application stops.
111    */
112   public static ServerBus create(BusPolicy policy) {
113      Objects.requireNonNull(policy, "policy");
114      var timer = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> {
115         var t = new Thread(r, "juneau-bus-timer");
116         t.setDaemon(true);
117         return t;
118      });
119      var bus = new ServerBus(policy, Clock.systemUTC(), timer);
120      var period = Math.min(1000L, policy.heartbeat().toMillis());
121      timer.scheduleAtFixedRate(bus::tickSafely, period, period, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
122      return bus;
123   }
124
125   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
126   // Application API
127   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
128
129   /**
130    * Publishes a value to every connected session granted the topic, and stores it if the topic is retained.
131    *
132    * <p>
133    * For a retained topic, a value whose JSON equals the stored JSON is not republished (distinct-until-changed).
134    *
135    * @param topic A concrete topic the policy allows downstream (not a {@code :*} pattern).
136    * @param payload The payload, serialized with {@link Json#of(Object)}.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>; use
137    *    {@link #clear(String)} to remove a retained value.
138    * @return <jk>false</jk> when the topic is retained and the value is unchanged; otherwise <jk>true</jk>.
139    * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-56 when the policy denies the topic or the frame is larger than
140    *    {@link BusPolicy#maxFrameBytes()}.
141    */
142   public boolean publish(String topic, Object payload) {
143      var retain = allowed("publish", topic);
144      var json = encode("publish", topic, payload);
145      synchronized (lock) {
146         if (retain) {
147            if (json.equals(retained.get(topic)))
148               return false;
149            retained.put(topic, json);
150         }
151         for (var s : List.copyOf(sessions.values()))
152            if (s.grants(topic))
153               s.send(seq -> BusFrames.pub(topic, json, retain, seq));
154      }
155      return true;
156   }
157
158   /**
159    * Removes a retained value and sends {@code clear} to every connected session granted the topic.
160    *
161    * <p>
162    * Clearing a topic that holds no value does nothing.
163    *
164    * @param topic A retained topic.
165    * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-56 when the policy denies the topic or does not retain it.
166    */
167   public void clear(String topic) {
168      if (! allowed("clear", topic))
169         throw e56("ServerBus.clear('%s'): the policy does not retain it", topic);
170      synchronized (lock) {
171         if (retained.remove(topic) == null)
172            return;
173         for (var s : List.copyOf(sessions.values()))
174            if (s.grants(topic))
175               s.send(seq -> BusFrames.clear(topic, seq));
176      }
177   }
178
179   /**
180    * Publishes a value to the connected sessions that match an audience.  Never retained, even on a retained topic.
181    *
182    * @param audience Selects sessions.  Runs under the bus lock: keep it cheap and side-effect free.
183    * @param topic A concrete topic the policy allows downstream.
184    * @param payload The payload.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
185    * @return The number of sessions that accepted the frame.
186    * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-56, as for {@link #publish(String, Object)}.
187    */
188   public int publishTo(Predicate<BusSession> audience, String topic, Object payload) {
189      Objects.requireNonNull(audience, "audience");
190      allowed("publishTo", topic);
191      var json = encode("publishTo", topic, payload);
192      var reached = 0;
193      synchronized (lock) {
194         for (var s : List.copyOf(sessions.values()))
195            if (s.isConnected() && s.grants(topic) && audience.test(s) && s.send(seq -> BusFrames.pub(topic, json, false, seq)))
196               reached++;
197      }
198      return reached;
199   }
200
201   /**
202    * The stored JSON of a retained topic.
203    *
204    * @param topic The topic.
205    * @return The JSON, or empty when nothing is stored.
206    */
207   public Optional<String> retainedJson(String topic) {
208      synchronized (lock) {
209         return Optional.ofNullable(retained.get(topic));
210      }
211   }
212
213   /**
214    * The live sessions (connected, or disconnected within their grace period).
215    *
216    * @return An immutable snapshot.
217    */
218   public List<BusSession> sessions() {
219      synchronized (lock) {
220         sweep(clock.instant());
221         return List.copyOf(sessions.values());
222      }
223   }
224
225   /** @return The policy this bus enforces. */
226   public BusPolicy policy() {
227      return policy;
228   }
229
230   /**
231    * Closes every connection with {@code 1001} ({@code bus:closed}), forgets every session and stops the timer.
232    * Retained values are kept.  Idempotent.
233    */
234   @Override /* AutoCloseable */
235   public void close() {
236      synchronized (lock) {
237         if (closed)
238            return;
239         closed = true;
240         for (var s : sessions.values())
241            s.detach(1001, "bus:closed");
242         sessions.clear();
243      }
244      if (timer != null)
245         timer.shutdownNow();
246   }
247
248   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
249   // Transport SPI
250   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
251
252   /**
253    * Transport SPI: opens a session from a session POST body.
254    *
255    * <p>
256    * Body: {@code {"v":1, "bridge":"ops", "transport":"sse"|"websocket", "downstream":[...], "upstream":[...]}}.
257    * {@code v} defaults to {@code 1} and {@code transport} to {@code "sse"}; {@code bridge} is required.
258    *
259    * @param req The POST request: the authorizer's argument and the source of the principal and session attributes.
260    * @param body The parsed body.  <jk>null</jk> is a 400.
261    * @return The new session.
262    * @throws BusRefusal 400 {@code bus:bad-request}, 403 {@code bus:topic-denied}, 429 {@code bus:too-many-sessions},
263    *    501 {@code bus:transport-unavailable}, or 503 {@code bus:closed}.
264    */
265   public BusSession openSession(HttpServletRequest req, JsonMap body) throws BusRefusal {
266      Objects.requireNonNull(req, "req");
267      if (body == null)
268         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("the session request must be a JSON object");
269      var v = body.get("v");
270      if (v != null && ! (v instanceof Number n && n.doubleValue() == BusFrames.VERSION))
271         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("unsupported bus version");
272      if (! (body.get("bridge") instanceof String bridge) || ! BusPolicy.BRIDGE_ID.matcher(bridge).matches())
273         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("bridge must be a valid id");
274      var t = body.get("transport");
275      if (t != null && ! (t instanceof String x && TRANSPORTS.contains(x)))
276         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("transport must be 'sse' or 'websocket'");
277      var transport = t == null ? "sse" : (String) t;
278      var downstream = topics(body, "downstream");
279      var upstream = topics(body, "upstream");
280      if (downstream.isEmpty() && upstream.isEmpty())
281         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("the session requests no topics");
282      if (! upstream.isEmpty() && ! "websocket".equals(transport))
283         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("upstream topics require the websocket transport");
284      if ("websocket".equals(transport) && webSocketPrefix == null)
285         throw BusRefusal.transportUnavailable();
286
287      var authorizer = policy.authorizer();
288      var denied = Stream.concat(
289         downstream.stream().filter(x -> policy.downstreamRetain(x).isEmpty() || ! authorizer.test(req, x)),
290         upstream.stream().filter(x -> ! policy.allowsUpstream(x) || ! authorizer.test(req, x))
291      ).toList();
292      if (! denied.isEmpty())
293         throw BusRefusal.topicDenied(echoable(denied));
294
295      var principal = req.getUserPrincipal();
296      var attributes = policy.sessionAttributes().apply(req);
297      synchronized (lock) {
298         if (closed)
299            throw new BusRefusal(503, "bus:closed", "the bus is closed", null, 0);
300         var now = clock.instant();
301         sweep(now);
302         if (sessions.size() >= policy.maxSessions())
303            throw BusRefusal.tooManySessions();
304         var s = new SessionImpl(newId(), bridge, transport, principal == null ? null : principal.getName(),
305            attributes, downstream, upstream, now);
306         sessions.put(s.id, s);
307         return s;
308      }
309   }
310
311   /**
312    * Transport SPI: finds a live session by its capability id, for the principal that opened it.
313    *
314    * @param id The session id from the request path.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
315    * @param principal The request principal.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (anonymous).
316    * @return The session, or empty when the id is unknown or expired, or the principal differs.  The three cases are
317    *    deliberately indistinguishable.
318    */
319   public Optional<BusSession> session(String id, Principal principal) {
320      if (id == null)
321         return Optional.empty();
322      synchronized (lock) {
323         var s = sessions.get(id);
324         if (s == null)
325            return Optional.empty();
326         if (s.expired(clock.instant())) {
327            expire(s);
328            return Optional.empty();
329         }
330         if (! Objects.equals(s.principalName, principal == null ? null : principal.getName()))
331            return Optional.empty();
332         return Optional.of(s);
333      }
334   }
335
336   /**
337    * Transport SPI: attaches a connection to a session, then sends the resync.
338    *
339    * <p>
340    * Any live sink is replaced and closed with {@code 4409} ({@code bus:replaced}).  The resync is
341    * {@code resync-begin}, one retained {@code pub} for every stored value the session's grant covers, in topic order,
342    * then {@code resync-end}.  When the bus is closed or the session has expired, the sink is closed at once
343    * ({@code 1001} / {@code 4401}).
344    *
345    * @param session A session of this bus.
346    * @param sink The connection's outbound side.
347    */
348   public void connect(BusSession session, FrameSink sink) {
349      var s = impl(session);
350      Objects.requireNonNull(sink, "sink");
351      synchronized (lock) {
352         if (closed) {
353            sink.close(1001, "bus:closed");
354            return;
355         }
356         if (sessions.get(s.id) != s) {
357            sink.close(4401, "bus:unknown-session");
358            return;
359         }
360         if (s.expired(clock.instant())) {
361            expire(s);
362            sink.close(4401, "bus:unknown-session");
363            return;
364         }
365         var old = s.sink.getAndSet(sink);
366         s.lastSent = clock.instant();
367         if (old != null)
368            old.close(4409, "bus:replaced");
369         if (! s.send(BusFrames::resyncBegin))
370            return;
371         for (var e : retained.entrySet())
372            if (s.grants(e.getKey()) && ! s.send(seq -> BusFrames.pub(e.getKey(), e.getValue(), true, seq)))
373               return;
374         s.send(BusFrames::resyncEnd);
375      }
376   }
377
378   /**
379    * Transport SPI: the connection behind a sink has closed.  Starts the session's grace period.
380    *
381    * <p>
382    * A sink that is no longer the session's live sink (it was replaced, or detached as a slow consumer) is ignored.
383    *
384    * @param session A session of this bus.
385    * @param sink The sink passed to {@link #connect(BusSession, FrameSink)}.
386    */
387   public void disconnect(BusSession session, FrameSink sink) {
388      var s = impl(session);
389      synchronized (lock) {
390         if (sink != null && s.sink.get() == sink) {
391            s.sink.set(null);
392            s.disconnectedAt = clock.instant();
393         }
394      }
395   }
396
397   /**
398    * Transport SPI: one upstream frame from a WebSocket connection.
399    *
400    * <p>
401    * Refusals are answered with an {@code error} frame and the frame is dropped; the connection stays open.
402    *
403    * @param session A session of this bus.
404    * @param frameText The frame text.
405    */
406   public void receive(BusSession session, String frameText) {
407      var s = impl(session);
408      synchronized (lock) {
409         if (sessions.get(s.id) != s)
410            return;
411         if (s.expired(clock.instant())) {
412            expire(s);
413            return;
414         }
415         if (! s.isConnected())
416            return;
417         if (! s.admitUpstream(clock.instant(), policy.maxUpstreamPerSecond())) {
418            s.offer(BusFrames.error("bus:rate-limited", "too many upstream frames", null));
419            return;
420         }
421      }
422      JsonMap frame;
423      try {
424         if (frameText != null && BusFrames.utf8Length(frameText) > policy.maxFrameBytes())
425            throw BusRefusal.badFrame("frame too large");
426         frame = BusFrames.decode(frameText);
427         if (! "pub".equals(frame.get("type")))
428            throw BusRefusal.badFrame("only pub frames may be sent upstream");
429         if (! (frame.get("payload") instanceof Map<?,?>))
430            throw BusRefusal.badFrame("an upstream payload must be a JSON object");
431      } catch (BusRefusal e) {
432         reply(s, BusFrames.error(e.code(), e.getMessage(), null));
433         return;
434      }
435      var topic = (String) frame.get("topic");
436      if (! s.upstream.contains(topic) || ! policy.allowsUpstream(topic)) {
437         var echo = BusPolicy.UPSTREAM_TOPIC.matcher(topic).matches() ? topic : null;
438         reply(s, BusFrames.error("bus:upstream-denied", "the session is not granted this upstream topic", echo));
439         return;
440      }
441      var p = (Map<?,?>) frame.get("payload");
442      var payload = p instanceof JsonMap j ? j : JsonMap.of(p);
443      try {
444         policy.upstreamHandler(topic).handle(s, topic, payload);
445      } catch (Exception e) {
446         if (e instanceof InterruptedException)
447            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
448         LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, e, () -> String.format("bus upstream handler for topic '%s' failed", topic));
449         reply(s, BusFrames.error("bus:upstream-failed", "handler failed", topic));
450      }
451   }
452
453   /**
454    * Transport SPI: records that the WebSocket transport is registered, so {@code transport:"websocket"} sessions may
455    * open and the session POST response carries {@code paths.websocket}.
456    *
457    * @param contextRelativePathPrefix The endpoint path without its {@code /{sessionId}} segment, for example
458    *    {@code /juneau-bus/ws}.  Must start with {@code /} and not end with {@code /}.
459    */
460   public void enableWebSocket(String contextRelativePathPrefix) {
461      if (contextRelativePathPrefix == null || ! contextRelativePathPrefix.startsWith("/") || contextRelativePathPrefix.endsWith("/"))
462         throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format(
463            "ServerBus.enableWebSocket: '%s' must start with '/' and must not end with '/'", contextRelativePathPrefix));
464      webSocketPrefix = contextRelativePathPrefix;
465   }

471   /** The WebSocket path prefix passed to {@link #enableWebSocket(String)}, or <jk>null</jk>. */
472   String webSocketPrefix() {
473      return webSocketPrefix;
474   }

476   /** The capability id of a session of any {@code ServerBus}.  Only the session POST response may carry it. */
477   static String idOf(BusSession session) {
478      return impl(session).id;
479   }
480
481   /**
482    * The SSE stream's subscription for a session (built on {@link SseBroadcaster}).
483    *
484    * <p>
485    * One per session, keyed by the session's non-secret stream key, never its capability id.  Subscribing again
486    * closes the previous subscription, which ends the earlier stream quietly; {@link #connect(BusSession, FrameSink)}
487    * then closes the earlier sink with {@code 4409}.  The queue holds {@link BusPolicy#maxQueuedFrames()} {@code + 1}
488    * events; see {@code SseFrameSink}.
489    *
490    * @param session A session of this bus.
491    * @return A new subscription.  The caller closes it when its stream ends.
492    */
493   SseSubscription subscribeSse(BusSession session) {
494      return sseStreams.subscribe(impl(session).streamKey);
495   }
496
497   /**
498    * The session POST's {@code 200} body.
499    *
500    * @param session A session of this bus.
501    * @param busBase The root-relative servlet path plus {@link BusEventsMixin#BUS_PREFIX}, e.g. {@code /rest/ops/juneau-bus}.
502    * @param contextPath The servlet context path ({@code ""} for the root context): WebSocket endpoints are
503    *    context-relative, not servlet-relative.
504    * @return The grant.  {@code paths.websocket} is present only after {@link #enableWebSocket(String)}.
505    */
506   JsonMap grant(BusSession session, String busBase, String contextPath) {
507      var s = impl(session);
508      var down = s.downstream.stream().map(t -> JsonMap.of("topic", t, "retain", policy.downstreamRetain(t).orElse(false))).toList();
509      var paths = JsonMap.of("sse", busBase + "/stream/" + s.id);
510      var ws = webSocketPrefix;
511      if (ws != null)
512         paths.put("websocket", (contextPath == null ? "" : contextPath) + ws + "/" + s.id);
513      return JsonMap.of("v", BusFrames.VERSION, "sessionId", s.id, "heartbeatMs", policy.heartbeat().toMillis(),
514         "graceMs", policy.sessionGrace().toMillis(), "downstream", down, "upstream", List.copyOf(s.upstream), "paths", paths);
515   }
516
517   /** Expires old sessions, closes connections past {@code maxSessionAge}, and pings idle connections. */
518   void tick() {
519      synchronized (lock) {
520         if (closed)
521            return;
522         var now = clock.instant();
523         sweep(now);
524         var idle = policy.heartbeat();
525         for (var s : List.copyOf(sessions.values()))
526            if (s.sink.get() != null && ! now.isBefore(s.lastSent.plus(idle)))
527               s.offer(BusFrames.ping());
528      }
529   }
530
531   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
532   // Internals
533   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
534
535   private void tickSafely() {
536      try {
537         tick();
538      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
539         // A scheduled task that throws is never run again; log and keep the timer alive.
540         LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "bus timer tick failed", e);
541      }
542   }
543
544   /** Returns the retain flag, or throws E-56.  A {@code :*} pattern is not a publishable topic. */
545   private boolean allowed(String method, String topic) {
546      if (topic == null || topic.endsWith(":*"))
547         throw e56("ServerBus.%s('%s'): the policy does not allow it downstream", method, topic);
548      return policy.downstreamRetain(topic)
549         .orElseThrow(() -> e56("ServerBus.%s('%s'): the policy does not allow it downstream", method, topic));
550   }
551
552   /** Serializes a payload and checks the worst-case frame size (a {@code false} flag and the longest {@code seq}). */
553   private String encode(String method, String topic, Object payload) {
554      if (payload == null)
555         throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("ServerBus.%s('%s'): payload must not be null; use clear(topic)", method, topic));
556      var json = Json.of(payload);
557      var size = BusFrames.utf8Length(BusFrames.pub(topic, json, false, Long.MAX_VALUE));
558      if (size > policy.maxFrameBytes())
559         throw e56("ServerBus.%s('%s'): frame too large (%s bytes, maxFrameBytes %s)", method, topic, size, policy.maxFrameBytes());
560      return json;
561   }
562
563   private void reply(SessionImpl s, String frame) {
564      synchronized (lock) {
565         s.offer(frame);
566      }
567   }
568
569   /** Guarded by lock. */
570   private void sweep(Instant now) {
571      for (var s : List.copyOf(sessions.values()))
572         if (s.expired(now))
573            expire(s);
574   }
575
576   /** Guarded by lock. */
577   private void expire(SessionImpl s) {
578      sessions.remove(s.id);
579      s.detach(4401, "bus:unknown-session");
580   }
581
582   /** Keeps only denied topics that are safe to echo in a 403 body: inside a topic grammar and short. */
583   private static List<String> echoable(List<String> denied) {
584      return denied.stream()
585         .filter(x -> x.length() <= MAX_ECHO_LENGTH && (BusPolicy.DOWNSTREAM_PATTERN.matcher(x).matches() || BusPolicy.UPSTREAM_TOPIC.matcher(x).matches()))
586         .toList();
587   }
588
589   private static List<String> topics(JsonMap body, String key) throws BusRefusal {
590      var o = body.get(key);
591      if (o == null)
592         return List.of();
593      if (! (o instanceof List<?> list) || list.size() > MAX_TOPICS)
594         throw BusRefusal.badRequest(String.format("%s must be a list of at most %s topics", key, MAX_TOPICS));
595      var out = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
596      for (var x : list) {
597         if (! (x instanceof String s) || s.isEmpty())
598            throw BusRefusal.badRequest(String.format("%s must be a list of at most %s topics", key, MAX_TOPICS));
599         out.add(s);
600      }
601      return List.copyOf(out);
602   }
603
604   private static String newId() {
605      var bytes = new byte[ID_BYTES];
606      RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
607      return HexFormat.of().formatHex(bytes);
608   }

610   private static SessionImpl impl(BusSession session) {
611      if (session instanceof SessionImpl s)
612         return s;
613      throw new IllegalArgumentException("ServerBus: not a session of a ServerBus");
614   }
615
616   private static IllegalArgumentException e56(String format, Object...args) {
617      return new IllegalArgumentException("E-56: " + String.format(format, args));
618   }
619
620   /** A session.  Every mutable field is guarded by the bus lock; {@code sink} is also atomic for {@link #isConnected()}. */
621   private final class SessionImpl implements BusSession {
622
623      final String id;
624      final String streamKey = "bus-" + STREAM_KEYS.incrementAndGet();
625      final String bridgeId;
626      final String transport;
627      final String principalName;
628      final Map<String,Object> attributes;
629      final Set<String> downstream;
630      final Set<String> upstream;
631      final Instant createdAt;
632
633      final AtomicReference<FrameSink> sink = new AtomicReference<>();
634      Instant disconnectedAt;
635      Instant lastSent;
636      long seq;
637      Instant windowStart = Instant.EPOCH;
638      int windowCount;
639
640      @SuppressWarnings({
641         "java:S107" // internal constructor; the parameters are the bus configuration
642      })
643      SessionImpl(String id, String bridgeId, String transport, String principalName, Map<String,Object> attributes,
644            List<String> downstream, List<String> upstream, Instant now) {
645         this.id = id;
646         this.bridgeId = bridgeId;
647         this.transport = transport;
648         this.principalName = principalName;
649         this.attributes = attributes == null ? Map.of() : Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(attributes));
650         this.downstream = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(downstream));
651         this.upstream = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(upstream));
652         this.createdAt = now;
653         this.disconnectedAt = now;
654         this.lastSent = now;
655      }
656
657      @Override public String bridgeId() { return bridgeId; }
658      @Override public String transport() { return transport; }
659      @Override public String principalName() { return principalName; }
660      @Override public Object attribute(String name) { return attributes.get(name); }
661      @Override public Set<String> downstream() { return downstream; }
662      @Override public Set<String> upstream() { return upstream; }
663      @Override public boolean isConnected() { return sink.get() != null; }
664
665      /** Whether the grant covers a concrete topic: an exact entry, or {@code family:*} for {@code family:key}. */
666      boolean grants(String topic) {
667         if (downstream.contains(topic))
668            return true;
669         var i = topic.indexOf(':');
670         return i > 0 && downstream.contains(topic.substring(0, i) + ":*");
671      }
672
673      /** Sends a frame that carries the next {@code seq}.  Not connected: nothing happens and seq is not consumed. */
674      boolean send(LongFunction<String> frame) {
675         if (sink.get() == null)
676            return false;
677         return offer(frame.apply(++seq));
678      }
679
680      /** Offers a frame; on a full queue detaches the sink and closes it with 4429. */
681      boolean offer(String frame) {
682         var k = sink.get();
683         if (k == null)
684            return false;
685         if (k.offer(frame)) {
686            lastSent = clock.instant();
687            return true;
688         }
689         detach(4429, "bus:slow-consumer");
690         return false;
691      }
692
693      void detach(int code, String reason) {
694         var k = sink.get();
695         if (k == null)
696            return;
697         sink.set(null);
698         disconnectedAt = clock.instant();
699         k.close(code, reason);
700      }
701
702      boolean expired(Instant now) {
703         if (! now.isBefore(createdAt.plus(policy.maxSessionAge())))
704            return true;
705         return sink.get() == null && ! now.isBefore(disconnectedAt.plus(policy.sessionGrace()));
706      }
707
708      boolean admitUpstream(Instant now, int max) {
709         if (! now.isBefore(windowStart.plusSeconds(1))) {
710            windowStart = now;
711            windowCount = 0;
712         }
713         return ++windowCount <= max;
714      }
715
716      @Override /* Object */
717      public String toString() {
718         return String.format("BusSession[bridge=%s, transport=%s, principal=%s, connected=%s, id=<redacted>]",
719            bridgeId, transport, principalName, isConnected());
720      }
721   }
722}
